notes.title: Spatial Audio Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/3365e981b8e63b73564a0bc19f27e9f388fc65d1.png

Gameplay:

 	Picked up weapons are now placed last in the arsenal instead of first.
 	3D Audio spatialization (Step, Jump, Dash, Shoot, Pickup).
 	Added hurt SFX.
 	Added empty mag SFX.


Graphics:

 	New models for: Health, Armor.
 	Texture rework for K-07.


Network:

 	Version check for connecting to servers.


Other:

 	Text chat rework: You can now use bbcode !
 	On screen error messages for multiplayer failure.
 	Slow on hit are now a weapon variable.
 


Fix:

 	Fixed spray orientation.
 	Spray texture was applied on some weapons.
